assessments.name: Round-table presentation and feedback on Astronomy Project ideas
assessments.description: Students will present their own project idea verbally and assess the project ideas of their peers. This will take place 3 times in the semester, students will be graded on the best out of the three sessions, based on peer and tutor assessment.

assessments.name: Small continuous assessment
assessments.description: Small participation tasks throughout semester. Discussion-based tasks within the tutorials based on the weekly content. These will take place in the weeks without the round-table presentations. Students will be graded on the best 5 of these ~8 sessions.

assessments.name: Early Feedback Task - Online Discussion Participation
assessments.description: Small online task based on unit content - students will post on the Ed forum either as a group or as an individual.
